{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Fairy| ball=None| pokemonname=Granbull| nickname=Granbull| jnickname=グランブル| tmnickname=Granbulu| image=[[File:Granbull Mystery Dungeon Red and Blue.png|240px]]| caption=The {{pkmn2|hero}} and the [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] speak to Granbull.| caught=no | gender=Male | ability=Unknown| evolution=1| firstevoep=Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team| prevonum=209| evo1num=210| epnum= Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team | current=At [[Pokémon Square]] | firststagename=Snubbull| secondstagename=Granbull| media=anime| java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Akio Suyama]]| java2=N/A | enva1=Unknown | }} '''Granbull''' (Japanese: '''グランブル''' ''Granbulu'') is a [[non-player character]] in {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team}}, and their [[remake]], {{g|Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX}}. ==In the games== Granbull was originally a Snubbull living in [[Pokémon Square]]. After the {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] were thought to be the cause of the natural disasters, Snubbull was one of the Pokémon who chased them. Snubbull gave up early on though, citing [[Lapis Cave]] to be the best he could hope to reach. Snubbull was later at [[Hill of the Ancients]] celebrating the victory of stopping the falling star from destroying the planet. Later, he evolved into Granbull after walking into [[Luminous Cave]]. At first, he was upset because his appearance had changed dramatically. {{color2|000|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX}} |} ==In animation== [[File:Snubbull Lombre PMD anime.png|thumb|250px|Snubbull in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'']] Granbull appeared as a Snubbull in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]''. He was first seen at [[Whiscash Pond]], along with {{p|Bellsprout}} and {{OBP|Lombre|Red and Blue Rescue Team}}. He informed {{OBP|Whiscash|Red and Blue Rescue Team}} that [[Team A.C.T.]] was on a mission to [[Magma Cavern]], much to Whiscash's sadness, as he had wished to sent them to rescue a {{p|Pichu}}'s older brother {{p|Pikachu}}. Later, when [[Team Meanies]] showed up, proposing to rescue Pikachu, Snubbull discussed what the {{OBP|Rank|Mystery Dungeon}} of Team Meanies would be.
